messages:
cheng: Quick question — trying to find logs for Acme org model 'gen-xl' in ap-sg where requests returned 5xx in the last 1h. Any saved search or dashboard? Also thinking alert threshold might be noisy.

alex: Use the LogSearch saved view "acme/gen-xl/ap-sg/5xx-rate" — exists but it's currently scoped to 24h. quick link: https://logs.redwood.example/app/kibana#/view/acme-genxl-apsg-5xx

maria: If you need the 1h view run this query in LogSearch: 
```
org:acme AND model:gen-xl AND region:ap-sg AND status:[500 TO 599] AND timestamp:[now-1h TO now]
```
That will give raw hits. For rate per minute use the metrics panel.

cheng: perfect — is that saved view editable? want to tweak to exclude internal-proxy 502s.

alex: yep you can duplicate and add `NOT route:/internal/proxy` filter. I can make a 1h saved view if you want.

maria: For alert tuning, we moved to p95 error-rate over 5m for customer-facing routes. For gen-xl in Acme I'd drop to 1.5% sustained for 5m (was 1%). That should reduce flapping from bursts.

cheng: sounds reasonable. any script to apply alert change or do we do manual in Alerting console?

ops-bot: alerting: created draft alert "acme-genxl-5xx-rate" in staging for review — https://console.redwood.example/alerts/alerts/ACME-GENXL-5XX

alex: i'll push the 1h saved view and link it on the dashboard. tagging @maria for alert review :thumbsup:

maria: reviewing now. small ask — add note to alert runbook to check kv-cache-misses tag, that's often correlated.

cheng: thanks all. if you push the saved view + alert change i'm happy to watch for noise over the next deploy.

alex: done — saved view: "acme/gen-xl/ap-sg/1h-5xx-ex-internal" and alert updated to 1.5% p95 over 5m. posting links in #eng-sre-pins.

cheng: awesome, appreciate it :rocket:
